reviewer: preparing Codex agent; not an independent examiner
scope: All 38 prompts read for standalone Task 2 instructions, primary-topic assignment, type, excluded answers, and question-family overlap; 703 pairs also receive lexical screening in validator.
decisions: band_verified rows 11 and 12 express the same relocation-for-work family: choose row 11 only, reserve it, and do not use the variant in practice.
Top18 paragraph 506 and band row 8 are interdependence variants: choose band row 8 only, reserved.
Top18 paragraph 216 and band row 9 are healthcare-tax-priority variants: choose Top18 paragraph 216 only, practice.
Top18 salary-cap question and band senior-management salary-gap question are potentially confusable compensation variants. Choose only the explicit national salary-cap question.

Climate adaptation, wildlife budget allocation, whether biodiversity intervention is too late, and freshwater rationing share environment but ask distinct policy propositions; retain distinct families.
Parent training (universal course requirement) and parental achievement pressure (causes and evaluation) have different propositions, although both concern parents; one is practice, one reserved.
Remote work and relocation away from family describe different work arrangements and burdens; retain distinct families, including across pools.
Historic building neglect is a new preservation-and-repair problem, distinct from responsible tourism, language funding and libraries.

problem_solution includes cause-and-remedy prompts (obesity; bicycle decline), as well as problem-and-measure prompts. two_part covers two non-remedy tasks such as causes-and-effects or causes-and-evaluation.
Technology and environment practice subpools do not each cover all five types; the quota requires five-type coverage across all 28 practice prompts, not a 7×5 matrix.
Health sleep-effects and school-uniform questions plus historic-building question were composed locally to fill genuine selection gaps; no borrowed model arguments or answers are included.
